title: Maximum Acceleration in Elliptic Planetary Orbit
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For an elliptical path r(t) = <5 cos(t), 3 sin(t)>, find the maximum magnitude of acceleration |a(t)|.

steps.title: Compute Acceleration Vector Function
steps.explanation: Differentiate position vector twice with respect to t.

steps.title: Determine Acceleration Magnitude Function
steps.explanation: Express magnitude using trigonometric identity sin^2(t) = 1 - cos^2(t).

steps.title: Find Global Maximum
steps.explanation: Maximum occurs at periapsis where cos^2(t) = 1.
